lat: tleqt l-kelb f l-jnan
en: I let the dog loose in the garden.

lat: ma tleqtsh mn yeddu f z-zenqa
en: I didn't let go of his hand in the street.

lat: tleqti l-ma f l-kuzina l-bare7
en: You turned on the water in the kitchen yesterday.

lat: 3lash ma tleqtish mn l-7bel l-bare7
ar: علاش ما طلقتيش من الحبل البارح
en: Why didn't you (m.) let go of the rope yesterday?

lat: nti tleqti l-qetta f d-dar
en: You (f.) let the cat loose in the house.

lat: ma tleqtish mn s-sak dyalek l-bare7
ar: ما طلقتيش من الصاك ديالك البارح
en: You (f.) didn't let go of your bag yesterday.

lat: huwa tleq l-7mama mn l-qfes
en: He released the dove from the cage.

lat: l-bulisi ma tleqsh sh-sheffar l-yum
en: The police officer didn't release the thief today.

lat: telqat sh-sha3r dyalha f l-7efla
en: She let her hair down at the party.

lat: hiya ma telqatsh mn yeddi f s-suq
ar: هي ما طلقاتش من يدي فالسوق
en: She didn't let go of my hand in the market.

lat: tleqna l-bqer f l-ghaba
en: We let the cows loose in the forest.

lat: ma tleqnash mn l-khayt b s-sor3a
en: We didn't let go of the string quickly.

lat: wash tleqtu l-ma f l-7emmam
en: Did you (pl.) turn on the water in the bathhouse?

lat: ma tleqtush mn l-bab dyal d-dar
ar: ما طلقتوش من الباب ديال الدار
en: You (pl.) didn't let go of the door of the house.

lat: telqu l-3asafer f s-sma l-bare7
en: They released the birds into the sky yesterday.

lat: huma ma telqush s-sarut mn yeddhum
ar: هما ما طلقوش الساروت من يدهم
en: They didn't let go of the key from their hand.

lat: kul sba7 kantleq d-djaj f l-jnan
en: Every morning I let the chickens loose in the garden.

lat: ana ma kantleqsh mn t-tilifun dyali
ar: انا ما كنطلقش من التيليفون ديالي
en: I don't let go of my phone.

lat: nta kattleq l-kelb f l-3shiya
en: You (m.) let the dog loose in the evening.

lat: 3lash ma kattleqsh mn l-kura daba
ar: علاش ما كتطلقش من الكورة دابا
en: Why don't you (m.) let go of the ball now?

lat: dima kattelqi sh-sha3r dyalek f d-dar
en: You (f.) always let your hair down at home.

lat: nti ma kattelqish mn bentek hna
ar: نتي ما كتطلقيش من بنتك هنا
en: You (f.) don't let go of your daughter here.

lat: kaytleq l-ma f l-jnan kul yum
en: He turns on the water in the garden every day.

lat: huwa ma kaytleqsh mn sh-shebka temma
ar: هو ما كيطلقش من الشبكة تما
en: He doesn't let go of the net there.

lat: hiya kattleq l-farasha mn l-qer3a
en: She releases the butterfly from the jar.

lat: hiya ma kattleqsh mn yeddu f z-za7ma
ar: هي ما كتطلقش من يدو فالزحمة
en: She doesn't let go of his hand in the crowd.

lat: kantelqu l-farkhat f s-ste7
en: We let the chicks out on the roof.

lat: 7na ma kantelqush mn l-7bel temma
ar: حنا ما كنطلقوش من الحبل تما
en: We don't let go of the rope there.

lat: kattelqu l-ma l-bard f s-sif
en: You (pl.) turn on cold water in the summer.

lat: ntuma ma kattelqush mn yeddin ba3diyatkum
ar: نتوما ما كتطلقوش من يدين بعضياتكم
en: You (pl.) don't let go of each other's hands.

lat: kaytelqu l-firan f l-khela kul merra
en: They release the mice into the wilderness each time.

lat: huma ma kaytelqush mn l-kabl dyalhum
ar: هما ما كيطلقوش من الكابل ديالهم
en: They don't let go of their cable.

lat: daba ghadi ntleq l-ma s-skhun
en: Now I am going to turn on the hot water.

lat: ma ghadish ntleq mn yeddek f sh-shari3
ar: ما غاديش نطلق من يدك فالشارع
en: I am not going to let go of your hand in the street.

lat: ghadi ttleq l-khruf f l-merj ghedda
en: You (m.) are going to let the lamb loose in the meadow tomorrow.

lat: wash ma ghadish ttleq mn l-kura
ar: واش ما غاديش تطلق من الكورة
en: Are you (m.) not going to let go of the ball?

lat: nti ghadi ttelqi l-3esfur mn l-qfes
ar: نتي غادي تطلقي العصفور من القفص
en: You (f.) are going to release the sparrow from the cage.

lat: ma ghadish ttelqi mn khtek f s-suq
ar: ما غاديش تطلقي من ختك فالسوق
en: You (f.) are not going to let go of your sister in the market.

lat: huwa ghadi ytleq l-kelb mn l-bit
ar: هو غادي يطلق الكلب من البيت
en: He is going to let the dog out of the room.

lat: ma ghadish ytleq mn l-khayt dyalu
ar: ما غاديش يطلق من الخيط ديالو
en: He is not going to let go of his thread.

lat: hiya ghadi ttleq l-qetta f l-jnan
en: She is going to release the cat in the garden.

lat: hiya ma ghadish ttleq mn yeddu ghedda
ar: هي ما غاديش تطلق من يدو غدا
en: She is not going to let go of his hand tomorrow.

lat: ghadi ntelqu l-7mam f s-ste7 ghedda
en: We are going to release the pigeons on the roof tomorrow.

lat: 7na ma ghadish ntelqu mn s-sarut
ar: حنا ما غاديش نطلقو من الساروت
en: We are not going to let go of the key.

lat: ntuma ghadi ttelqu l-kelb f d-dar
en: You (pl.) are going to let the dog loose in the house.

lat: 3lash ma ghadish ttelqu mn l-bab
ar: علاش ما غاديش تطلقو من الباب
en: Why are you (pl.) not going to let go of the door?

lat: huma ghadi ytelqu l-ma f l-werd
en: They are going to turn on the water for the flowers.

lat: ma ghadish ytelqu l-kelb f z-zenqa
en: They are not going to let the dog loose in the street.
